means.en: The substance that gets dissolved in a solution. In salt water, the salt is the solute.
The substance that dissolves the solute. In salt water, the water is the solvent.
The maximum amount of a solute that dissolves in a fixed quantity of solvent at a given temperature, usually in grams per 100 g of water.
A saturated solution cannot dissolve any more solute at that temperature.
Forming crystals from a saturated solution. It gives a pure solid.
The liquid collected after distillation, when the vapour has been cooled.

plain.en: the part that cools the vapour

means.en: A tube with cold water around it. Vapour passing through turns back into liquid.
colour
writing
A method that separates dissolved substances because each travels its own distance on paper.
Immiscible liquids do not mix, so they form separate layers. Mustard oil and water are immiscible.
Miscible liquids mix completely. Water and alcohol are miscible.
On heating, below its melting point, a solid changes directly into vapour without becoming a liquid.
On cooling, a vapour changes back into a solid without becoming a liquid.
A homogeneous mixture of two or more metals, or of a metal and a non-metal. Brass is an alloy.
A heterogeneous mixture whose solid particles do not dissolve but stay spread through the liquid. Its particles can be seen.
Spinning a mixture very fast, so that the denser part moves outwards much faster than it would sink.
Adding a substance that makes tiny particles clump together, so that they settle.
The substance added to make tiny particles clump together. Alum is a coagulant.
A heterogeneous mixture with particles from 1 to 1000 nm. It does not settle and it scatters light.
The scattering of light by the particles in a colloid or a suspension, which makes the path of a beam visible.

plain.en: the part that is spread out

means.en: In a colloid, the tiny particles that are spread through the other part.
In a colloid, the part in which the dispersed phase is spread.
A colloid in which both parts are liquids. Milk is an emulsion of oil in water.
